summary: A status or alert region that a user can dismiss with a native button and restore through its public reset method.

behavior.given: the component is visible and has a valid native dismiss button
then: the host hidden property becomes true
the host data-state attribute becomes dismissed
one bubbling and composed nuk-dismiss event is dispatched with detail.dismissed=true
the host hidden property becomes false
the host data-state attribute becomes visible

behavior.given: the component is reconnected or its light-DOM dismiss button changes
then: any listener on the previous button is removed
at most one click listener is registered on the current valid button

behavior.given: the host has an invalid role or lacks a named native type=button dismiss control
then: one bubbling and composed nuk-config-error event identifies the authoring error

keyboard: Use a native button so Enter and Space activation are provided by the browser.
Do not add a positive tabindex or intercept unrelated keys.
naming: The dismiss button must have non-empty visible text or aria-label.
The host role must be status for ordinary feedback or alert only for urgent feedback.
screenReader: Do not move focus when the component appears or is dismissed.
The author must move focus before dismissing an alert that contains current focus.
forcedColors: The structural implementation does not suppress system colors or focus indicators.
reducedMotion: The structural implementation introduces no animation or transition.

acceptanceTests.assertion: Activating the valid native button dismisses the host and emits the specified event once.
reset() restores visible state without moving focus.
Invalid role or unnamed/non-button dismiss controls do not initialize and surface a configuration error event.
The implementation registers only nuk-dismissible-alert and uses light DOM with a native button.
The implementation contains no forbidden capability and imports no undeclared dependency.
